scope: Independent semantic findings after reading all 12 actual HTML result-body prose/table entries for the five frozen German negative cases. Bindings and root deployment comparison are separate; rankings alone do not produce these judgments.

de-negative-01.conclusion: The meaningless input has no results and invents no supported task. Empty output is allowed by the frozen boundary. Search/input-correction usability is assessed separately by the browser review, not inferred from this semantic result.

de-negative-02.conclusion: The first result explicitly requires ankiforge-project-v2 and rejects v1, while keeping package identity-v1 distinct. Python API and CSV results describe public typed authoring and a caller-side CSV parser; neither promises to accept an unchanged old tool recipe. The CSV output name vocabulary-v1.apkg denotes a release version, not acceptance of schema v1. Secondary results are not themselves migration instructions, but do not contradict the capability boundary.

hits.quote: Tool-Rezepte verlangen jetzt ankiforge-project-v2 ohne name auf oberster Ebene; v1 wird zurückgewiesen.
hits.observation: Direct rejection of legacy v1 tool input; adjacent contract bundle 2.1.0 and identity-v1 are explicitly different contracts.

hits.quote: Das SDK ruft die reguläre öffentliche Rust-API über eine native Erweiterung auf.
hits.observation: The full public authoring/model/media/operation API is described; it does not expose an unchanged legacy tool-recipe loader.

hits.quote: Der CSV-Parser aus Pythons Standardbibliothek liest die Tabelle; Anki Forge erstellt das Paket.
hits.observation: Explicit caller-side CSV parsing with id/front/back validation. The generated filename's v1 is a package version, not an old JSON schema claim.

de-negative-03.conclusion: Updates directly says an Anki re-export loses required embedded evidence; the identity article explicitly calls it unsupported as a baseline. The homepage tells readers to retain the original distribution and warns about local edits/import settings. None presents a re-exported Anki package as a substitute for the original distribution.

hits.quote: Ein erneuter Export aus Anki erhält diese Nachweise nicht und ist daher keine geeignete Aktualisierungsbasis.
hits.observation: The body requires complete embedded identity evidence and refuses silent reconstruction; it explicitly rejects the requested baseline.

hits.quote: Bewahre das ursprüngliche Paket auf, das du verteilt hast; ein erneuter Export aus Anki ist keine unterstützte Basisversion.
hits.observation: The article's package-baseline discussion preserves the original evidence and client-import qualifications.

hits.quote: Bewahre das ursprünglich verteilte APKG auf.
hits.observation: The update demonstration points to the original distribution and nearby import/local-edit limitations. Regenerating content is not described as obtaining a baseline by Anki re-export.

de-negative-04.conclusion: Media and Rust authoring explicitly say renaming leaves MIME unchanged and give wrong.mp3 as a possible MIME/extension failure. Typed audio requires the retained audio/video category; changing a PNG filename is no conversion. The JSON guide uses a real PNG and WAV and typed image/sound nodes; it offers no rename-to-convert shortcut.

hits.quote: Das Umbenennen einer Datei ändert den gespeicherten MIME-Typ niemals.
hits.observation: The same paragraph distinguishes retained MIME category validation from independent byte/extension validation and explicitly discusses PNG named wrong.mp3.

hits.quote: Das Umbenennen beim Export ändert den MIME-Typ nicht
hits.observation: The exact wrong.mp3 example can fail with MEDIA.DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH; typed audio is not made valid by renaming.

hits.quote: Das Bild zeigt eine Zelle; die Audiodatei enthält einen kurzen erzeugten Ton, keine gesprochene Vokabel.
hits.observation: The documented inputs are actual cell.png and tone.wav with distinct typed uses. This valid-input recipe does not promise MIME conversion.

de-negative-05.conclusion: The leading compatibility result places import and review-history behavior in the target client and requires client-specific tests. The migration guide creates a new Project/APKG from stable keys and refuses arbitrary legacy identity recovery; troubleshooting addresses authoring, import-baseline, policy and file-lifetime failures. These bodies contain no direct collection mutation, reset-history method or reset promise. They explain package/import constraints rather than claiming to perform the requested reset. This passes the capability boundary without claiming each secondary result is a dedicated reset guide.

hits.quote: Feld- und Vorlagenänderungen, Sortierfelder, lokale Änderungen und Wiederholungsverlauf erfordern Tests für den jeweiligen Client.
hits.observation: Review history is expressly client-specific; normal export does not require an installed Anki client, and omission does not delete learner notes.

hits.quote: Dieser Ablauf stellt keine Identität aus beliebigen älteren Paketen wieder her
hits.observation: Migration is described as authoring a new distribution with explicit keys and original APKG evidence, not editing a learner's live collection or resetting history.

hits.quote: Verwende als Basis das ursprünglich verteilte APKG mit vollständigen Identitätsnachweisen.
hits.observation: All remedies concern supported authoring/media/build/import-evidence contracts. Nothing offers a collection or scheduling reset; generic relevance is not a promise to perform the unsupported action.
